findings.title: runc container escape (Leaky Vessels)
findings.description: File descriptor leak in runc allows container escape to host OS.
findings.justification: Our Kubernetes node pool uses gVisor (runsc) as the container runtime, not runc directly.
findings.compensatingControls: gVisor sandbox on all prod nodes.

findings.title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset DoS
findings.description: HTTP/2 rapid reset via stream cancellation causes unauthenticated remote DoS.
findings.justification: Cloudflare WAF absorbs reset floods before reaching origin.

audit.action: Risk Accepted — signed off by CISO

findings.title: OpenSSL AES-NI buffer overflow
findings.description: Buffer overflow in AES-NI implementation. Requires local access.
findings.justification: API containers run as non-root; no local user access.
findings.compensatingControls: Network policies restrict pod-to-pod; no shell access.

findings.title: Spring Framework path traversal
findings.description: Path traversal in Spring ResourceHandler. Requires authenticated request.
findings.justification: Static assets served from CDN; handler not exposed.

findings.title: XZ Utils backdoor
findings.description: Malicious backdoor in XZ Utils 5.6.0–5.6.1 targeting sshd on systemd-enabled Linux.
findings.justification: Alpine/musl — no systemd, no sshd. The liblzma code path is not reachable.

findings.title: Apache httpd HTTP/2 CONTINUATION flood
findings.description: HTTP/2 CONTINUATION frame flooding exhausts server memory/CPU.

findings.title: Log4Shell RCE — REGRESSION
findings.description: JNDI injection in Apache Log4j2 allows unauthenticated RCE. Regression detected.

findings.title: Tomcat session fixation
findings.description: Session fixation possible when using default session config.
findings.justification: We use Spring Security with custom session management.
findings.reviewerNote: Rejected — justification insufficient. Please provide config evidence.

findings.title: Palo Alto PAN-OS command injection
findings.description: Command injection in GlobalProtect gateway. Pushed from Trivy CI scan.

findings.title: runc container escape (from Trivy image scan)
findings.description: File descriptor leak in runc. Detected by Trivy in CI pipeline.

findings.title: Jackson polymorphic deserialization
findings.description: Polymorphic deserialization can lead to RCE via crafted JSON.
findings.justification: API only accepts whitelisted DTOs; ObjectMapper defaultTyping disabled.
findings.compensatingControls: Input validation; no @JsonTypeInfo on API models.
findings.reviewerNote: Suppressed — contextual. Same CVE on other services still requires triage.

findings.title: Netty HTTP request smuggling
findings.description: HTTP request smuggling via chunked encoding.
findings.justification: We run behind AWS ALB which normalizes requests. Netty never sees raw HTTP.
findings.compensatingControls: ALB terminates HTTP; backend receives normalized requests.

findings.title: Bouncy Castle timing attack
findings.description: Timing side-channel in RSA implementation.
findings.justification: Upgrade blocked by compatibility. Compensating controls in place.
findings.compensatingControls: Rate limiting; HSM for key operations; monitoring.

findings.title: AWS Access Key exposed in .env file
findings.description: Hardcoded AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY in .env. SLA 24h.

findings.title: S3 bucket ACL set to public-read
findings.description: S3 bucket 'app-assets-prod' configured with ACL: public-read in Terraform.
findings.justification: Bucket hosts public static assets. Policy limits read to /public/* prefix.
findings.compensatingControls: Bucket policy limiting public access to /public/* prefix.

findings.title: Linux kernel privilege escalation
findings.description: VM host (prod-web-01) kernel vulnerability. Requires local access to exploit.

findings.title: AGPL-3.0 dependency in commercial product
findings.description: Package 'agpl-client@2.3.1' is AGPL-3.0. Commercial use requires source disclosure.

findings.title: OpenSSH auth bypass on VM
findings.description: VM host (db-server-02) — OpenSSH auth bypass. Database server VM.
findings.justification: Restricting to VPN-only access.

findings.title: Sudo privilege escalation on VM
findings.description: VM host (batch-worker-01) — sudo CVE allows local privilege escalation.

findings.title: XSS in user profile render
findings.description: Reflected XSS in profile page — user input not escaped in React.

findings.title: Lodash prototype pollution in frontend
findings.description: Lodash prototype pollution in org/frontend-app dependencies.
findings.justification: Upgraded lodash to 4.17.21.

findings.title: EC2 instance exposed to 0.0.0.0/0
findings.description: Terraform module in infra/terraform-modules — EC2 security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22.

findings.title: SQL injection in user lookup
findings.description: User input concatenated into SQL query in src/db/users.py.

findings.title: Express qs prototype pollution

findings.justification: Upgraded to express 4.19.x

findings.title: OpenSSH double-free in sshd
findings.description: Double-free in sshd when processing certain auth requests.

findings.title: Duplicate of CVE-2024-21626

findings.title: Guava cache DoS
findings.description: Cache DoS via crafted keys.

findings.title: SnakeYAML deserialization
findings.description: Unsafe deserialization in SnakeYAML.
findings.justification: We only parse trusted config files.

findings.title: HikariCP connection leak
findings.description: Connection leak under load.
findings.justification: Fixed in 5.0.2.

findings.title: SLF4J log injection
findings.description: Log injection via crafted input.
findings.justification: Logs are internal only; no user-facing impact.

findings.title: JUnit platform reflection
findings.description: Reflection in test framework.
findings.justification: Test-only dependency; not in prod runtime.

findings.title: Commons Text RCE
findings.description: Script interpolation in Commons Text.

findings.title: Logback JNDI

tracker.issueTemplate:
[VAT] {finding_id}

---
### Vulnerability Assessment Response
Post the block below as a **comment** to update this finding in VAT.

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| status | `false-positive` \| `not-applicable` \| `risk-accepted` \| `mitigated` \| `duplicate` |
| justification | _(required — explain why; cite evidence for false-positive)_ |
| compensating-controls | _(optional — e.g. WAF, network segmentation, monitoring)_ |

**Copy-paste and fill in:**
```
[VAT] {finding_id}
status: 
justification: 
compensating-controls: 
```
